decisions.reason: The revised bushing retention and sliding interface do not change the lug fabrication sequence, hole spacing, or unresolved face-machining treatment.
Preparing the drawings with the revised bushing arrangement does not change the required drawing template, numbering, or presentation conventions.
The bushing design revision does not alter the obligation to deliver a 3D model or its accepted file formats.
The source changes the bushing arrangement represented in the drawings but does not change the independent obligation to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The source specifies bushing retention and motion but does not add, remove, or revise any drawing-dimension annotation requirement.
